narrative:
Material PL3__MCCFF617 exhibits erratic demand patterns with high variability (CV=1.80). 
The demand shows 27.8% non-zero days, indicating sporadic usage. 
Lead time variability is also low, contributing to supply uncertainty.

The optimized policy recommends a safety stock of 8 units to achieve 95% service level,
with reorder point at 11 units. The MOQ constraint of 455 units is active, 
driving the order quantity. Storage capacity is sufficient with 858.1 units headroom.

The new policy increases annual costs by $10.83 but provides significantly better service protection
against stockouts given the erratic demand regime.
